For the Petitioner : Mr. Somitra Baroi,
Advocate For the State : Mrs. Amrita Kumari, A.P.P.
---------
04/ 19.05.2023 This is the second Bail Application on behalf of the applicant-Indrajit Mahato @
Indrajeet Mahato @ Azad with the prayer to release on bail in connection with Baliapur P.S. Case
No. 191 of 2021, corresponding to S.T. Case No. 50 of 2022, registered under Sections 376, 506 of
the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of the Additional Sessions Judge-III, Dhanbad.

2.  The learned Counsel for the applicant has submitted that earlier first Bail Application of the applicant was rejected vide order dated 29.06.2022 and by way of this present application the prayer has been renewed for the reason that after rejection of the first Bail Application, the charge was framed on 23.06.2022 and till date no one witness has been examined on behalf of the prosecution.
The applicant has been languishing in Jail since 02.11.2021.
3. The learned A.P.P. opposed the contentions made by learned Counsel for the applicant.
4. The first Bail Application of the applicant was rejected in B.A.No. 999 of 2022 vide order dated 29.06.2022.
The charge was framed on 23.06.2022 and if no charge-sheeted witnesses have been examined by the prosecution, the same cannot be a new ground for the second Bail Application.
5. Keeping in view the nature and gravity of the offence, the length of judicial custody cannot be taken into consideration as a ground for the second Bail Application.
6. In view of the above, the Bail Application of the applicant is rejected.
7. However, the the trial court is directed to expedite the trial, as prayed by the learned Counsel for the applicant.
